title: verbena dissecta f. glandulifera
intro: Verbena dissecta f. glandulifera, commonly known as a flowering plant species in the Verbenaceae family, is also referred to as a type of Verbena plant. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The plant has been found to have several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Verbena dissecta f. glandulifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antispasmodic, and antiseptic effects.
